inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: This is how the machinery works: a judge blocks a prolife law, and suddenly the story is no longer about protecting unborn lives but about institutions defending abortion under the banner of religious freedom. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice supplied the argument; the system’s framing makes the inversion look principled and any limit look oppressive. That doesn’t feel like an accidental shift in emphasis—it looks like a coordinated way to steer what people are allowed to see as the real issue.
